description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520002 (23/0033)
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 53 and No. 70) with detailed property information including owner names, extent, location details, and title classifications. The content is exclusively focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
